title: DigitalOcean Personal access token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: dox_v1_ vs the three documented prefixes dop_v1_/doo_v1_/dor_v1_. Twin of "DigitalOcean OAuth token, DigitalOcean Personal access token and 1 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
